correctness.rationale: The proof derives an m*d incidence-budget upper bound, solves its cardinality-layer knapsack exactly, proves an equitable uniform hypergraph exchange lemma, and realizes every optimal family using an internal matching/path/triangle and independent witness vertices. Each marked degree equals its family incidence, every witness has degree at most d, and each host vertex has a unique trace. Handles d=0, m=1, layer endpoints, high d and VC dimension. Reproducible checker exercises 2,097,151 small-graph instances and explicit extremizers; finite tests are not substituted for the all-size proof.

value.rationale: An exact all-size growth function and phase diagram for one-types in the natural hereditary class of maximum-degree-bounded graphs, together with exact VC threshold, threshold-family rigidity, and minimal-order identifying hosts. These are substantive structural and extremal claims beyond qualitative bounded-expansion linearity or a one-parameter routine upper bound. For fixed d the exact leading coefficient (d+1)/2 is information-theoretically tight; the minimum-host theorem encodes optimal type families without redundant vertices.
